title.zh: Binance Will List Hyperliquid’s HYPE Token With Seed Tag - tokenpost.com
title.en: Binance Will List Hyperliquid’s HYPE Token With Seed Tag - tokenpost.com

current_state.zh: Binance 已确认将上线 Hypeliquid（HYPE）并附带 Seed Tag，开放 HYPE/USDT、HYPE/USDC、HYPE/TRY 现货交易对，交易于 2026-09-24 11:00 UTC 启动。
current_state.en: Binance confirmed it will list Hyperliquid (HYPE) with the Seed Tag applied, opening HYPE/USDT, HYPE/USDC, and HYPE/TRY spot pairs with trading starting 2026-09-24 11:00 UTC.
